scientific_question: How does the accepted project-defined H2 teacher-path solution respond to prescribed supersonic inlet Mach number when inlet static p/T, dry-air composition, geometry, phi, injector location, mixing closure and numerical controls are frozen?

boundary_parameterization.frozen_inlet_composition: teacher H2 dry-air basis at phi=eta=0
boundary_parameterization.density_rule: rho = p/(R*T); invariant across target Mach because p/T/composition are frozen
boundary_parameterization.air_mass_flow_rule: m_dot_air = rho*u*A_in; therefore varies linearly with target Mach
boundary_parameterization.fuel_mass_flow_rule: m_dot_f = phi*f_st*m_dot_air; therefore changes proportionally with air mass flow while fuel/air ratio remains fixed
boundary_parameterization.interpretation_boundary: This is a fixed-static-state inlet-Mach sensitivity, not a fixed-total-pressure/total-temperature flight-Mach sweep.

frozen_controls.geometry: P11.4 project-defined 0.40 m mild linear-divergence geometry

preregistered_algebraic_expectations: At fixed inlet T and composition, sound speed is invariant across the study.
Derived inlet axial velocity is exactly proportional to target inlet Mach.
At fixed inlet p/T/composition/area, inlet density is invariant and inlet air mass flow is proportional to target Mach.
At fixed equivalence ratio, injected fuel mass flow is proportional to inlet air mass flow and fuel/air mass ratio remains invariant.
No monotonic Mach, pressure, temperature, convergence-step, or conservation-diagnostic response is assumed a priori for the coupled CFD solution.

numerical_design.grid_role: robustness diagnostic only; no formal grid-independence/GCI claim

status_policy.guard_interpretation: solver/model-domain inadmissible only; not unstart or a combustion-mode label

prohibited_claims: flight-Mach performance law under fixed total conditions
experimental validation from the supporting literature
ramjet/scramjet/dual-mode/unstart classification from guard or extrema
formal grid independence from the 20/40 comparison
